convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom 'BullsBears' indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator with proprietary smoothing methods cannot be auto-converted.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total (minimum bars for indicator calculation)
derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated check and bars sufficiency check

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec (chart period in seconds)
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Sell position closed when UpTrend crosses above DnTrend (if SellPosClose=true)
Buy position closed when UpTrend crosses below DnTrend (if BuyPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM values are treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 = 0.1 lots), positive MM values are treated as deposit fraction for lot calculation. Logic handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses previous bar (SignalBar=1 by default) compared to bar before that: UpTrend[1]>DnTrend[1] for current direction, UpTrend[0]<=DnTrend[0] for prior bar crossover detection. Signal is only processed on new bar or when Recount is triggered. The EA uses two buffers from BullsBears indicator: buffer 1 (UpTrend/Bulls) and buffer 0 (DnTrend/Bears). BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose input booleans act as permission gates for each trade direction and action. LoadHistory() is called each tick to ensure series data availability. GlobalVariableDel_() cleans up global variables on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The BullsBears custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It relies on SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which provides multiple smoothing methods (MODE_LWMA, JJMA, VIDIA, AMA etc.) via the CXMA class. The smoothing method is configurable via XMA_Method input. The trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and encapsulate position management, lot sizing (conditional on MM sign), SL/TP setting, and deviation handling - all must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class for new bar detection must also be ported. SL/TP values are in points (not pips), so 1000 points on a 5-digit broker = 100 pips; no explicit digit adjustment is present in the code itself but the TradeAlgorithms.mqh may handle it internally. Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec which approximates the next bar open time.
